templates.name: Quiet shop
templates.description: A calm, steady tour. Good for a normal evening with a few viewers.
ideas: Check your pitch lengths on the Products tab first (about 35 s per product is the sweet spot).

templates.name: Flash sale night
templates.description: Faster tour and an upbeat host to support a real discount.
ideas: Start a flash sale in Live tools with your real price and real stock. Leave stock empty if you do not count it.

templates.name: New product launch
templates.description: Greets everyone who joins and keeps the tour moving, so new viewers feel seen.
ideas: Run a 5-minute giveaway early so people stay for the launch.
Teach the host the 3 questions you expect (size, material, shipping).

templates.name: Expert demo
templates.description: Slower, explanatory pace for tools, tech and kitchenware. Longer pauses for questions.
ideas: Fill in 'How to use' for each product so the host can explain it.

templates.name: Q&A hour
templates.description: No automatic tour. The host only answers what viewers ask. You do the talking.
ideas: Open the Teach tab after the live and answer what the host was not sure about.

templates.name: Giveaway party
templates.description: High-energy host, joins greeted, tour in the background while you run mini games.
ideas: Start a giveaway and a poll in Live tools. Only offer a prize you will really send.

templates.name: Overnight (AI alone)
templates.description: For hours when you are away: steady tour, no join greetings, minimal chatter. Use with Coverage.
ideas: Set your own hours in Coverage so the host stays quiet while you are on camera.
Say clearly in your bio that the host is an AI.

templates.name: Just chatting
templates.description: A friendly chat buddy, no products. Remembers returning viewers if you allow it.
ideas: Run a poll to get chat talking.

templates.name: Quiet co-host
templates.description: Speaks only when asked. Good for gaming, music or study lives.
ideas: Thank gifts and follows only. Everything else stays yours.
